title: Janus solar evaporators: a review of innovative technologies and diverse applications
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3502-3525
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00159E, Review Article
Boli Nie, Yanming Meng, Simeng Niu, Longjie Gong, Yufeng Chen, Liujun Guo, Xiang Li, Yan-Chao Wu, Hui-Jing Li, Weiwei Zhang
This review commences with a comprehensive examination of the merits possessed by Janus film based ISE. Subsequently, it elaborates in detail from aspects such as structure, manufacturing materials, and practical applications.
